title: Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes: Uplift on a Piece the Chain Sold, by Length of Ownership
content:
Clause on the uplift taken on the gain in fixing the least the customer must spend under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes. For a piece the chain itself sold, the uplift depends on how long the customer has owned it.

## Clause

Where the customer has owned the piece for at least five years and the chain sold it, the uplift is seventy-five percent (75 percent). Where the customer has owned it for less than five years and the chain sold it, the uplift is one hundred and twenty percent (120 percent). Otherwise, which is to say where the chain did not sell the piece, no such uplift applies and the uplift is the one the programme publishes.

Five years is counted as 1825 calendar days from the date the piece was originally bought, as recorded on the registration, to the handling date. The chain sold the piece where an original sales receipt is recorded against the registration.

## Day-count boundaries

| Chain sold the piece | Calendar days owned | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 1825 or more | 75 percent |
| yes | 1824 or fewer | 120 percent |
| no | any | the programme's published uplift |

A piece bought exactly 1825 days before the handling date has been owned for at least five years; a piece bought 1824 days before has not.

## Hypothetical gains

On a gain of 2000 USD: at 75 percent the uplift leg is 1500.00 USD; at 120 percent it is 2400.00 USD.
